### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**1** anchor(s) derived from **2** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them. ⚠️ **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/metadata-core/src/package-closure.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/metadata-core/src/package-closure.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- the SDK route bridge reached **69** of **252** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **183** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **183**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **124** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **9** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 6e8f663710ccfe069138d0fe8ba1ccbd98111ed3` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `db3d9c21ccfd58817e23447a1e320780e81eb058` — the merge of head `8b3de84ee4b2290844df37a8b2d22582b1c2170d` into base `6e8f663710ccfe069138d0fe8ba1ccbd98111ed3`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin db3d9c21ccfd58817e23447a1e320780e81eb058 && git checkout db3d9c21ccfd58817e23447a1e320780e81eb058
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 6e8f663710ccfe069138d0fe8ba1ccbd98111ed3 8b3de84ee4b2290844df37a8b2d22582b1c2170d && git checkout -B drift-repro 6e8f663710ccfe069138d0fe8ba1ccbd98111ed3 && git merge --no-ff 8b3de84ee4b2290844df37a8b2d22582b1c2170d

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 6e8f663710ccfe069138d0fe8ba1ccbd98111ed3
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `8b3de84ee4b2290844df37a8b2d22582b1c2170d`
Local-runs: none
Scope: docs/adr/0150-behavioural-metadata-addressed-by-package-objects-keep-the-literal-prefix.md,packages/lint/src/validate-ai-tool-references.test.ts,packages/lint/src/validate-ai-tool-references.ts,packages/metadata-core/src/package-closure.ts + none
Security-touching: no

PR #37795 for card #37745. Inputs read: the card body and its three comments (triage 7207161910, claim 7208670610, dev report 7209271380), the PR body and file list (5 files, +57/-8), the net diff against `main` (merge base `149085573d`), and the check-runs on this head. Read with git only; nothing built or run. The remainder of the diff is the changeset `.changeset/37745-lint-context-hint-no-package.md`, which is the lane seat's ACCEPT.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept-set: unchanged. Right.** No schema, no rule id, no severity and no resolution path changes. `contextRefusalFinding` still returns one finding for the same refusals; only the `hint` string of one arm differs.
- **Public surface: one lint hint string. Right.** For `ai-skill-context-unknown` refused as `ambiguous-in-environment`, the hint changes from "Keep one pack of that name in reach of this package, or name another pack" to "Keep one pack of that name across the artifact's packages, or name another pack". The message of that arm, and the message and hint of the `ambiguous-in-closure` and `outside-closure` arms, are byte-identical in the diff.
- **The arm is selected by the right value. Right.** `noCallerPackage` is `refusal.reason === 'ambiguous-in-environment'`. In `packages/metadata-core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts` that reason is returned only by `resolveEnvironmentWide`, which `resolvePackageScopedHolders` enters when the caller package is null. The lint resolver passes `callerPackageId: ownId`, and `ownId` is null exactly when the stack has no `manifest.id`.
- **Exports: unchanged. Right.** `skillContextResolver` and `contextRefusalFinding` stay module-private; `packages/metadata-core/src/package-closure.ts` changes a header comment only.
- **Gate verdicts.** 69 check-runs on this head: 58 success, 11 skipped, 0 failed. Among the successes: `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core` (10 shards), `Check Changeset`, `Check Documentation Links`, `PR-body guards`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`.

### ② Semver level

Clause-②: no

The changeset is `patch` for `@objectstack/lint` alone, and it carries `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, as the PR body and the card's acceptance do. That matches what the diff publishes: one advisory hint string, with nothing that validated before now refused and no export changed. `@objectstack/metadata-core` gets no changeset, and that is right: its edit is a comment and publishes nothing. `Check Changeset` concluded success.

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: empty in the dev report. Nothing to answer.
- Dev deviation, acceptance 1 (the `{@link}` is not resolved by a tool): accepted. The card words it "if the package runs one", and `packages/lint/package.json` runs no typedoc. `function skillContextResolver(` is declared in the same module at this head, and `skillContextResolution` named no symbol.
- Dev deviation, ADR-0150 edit covers five lines, not one: accepted. Card item 5 leaves the choice to the dev ("decide whether to point them at metadata-core in the same edit"), and the claim's file surface allows it while the anchor gate stays green.
- Dev deviations on the shallow checkout, the shared verify lock, `test:repo` left to CI and the not-measured `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`: no effect on this record. The check-runs on the head are the gate verdicts here, and they are green.
- Out-of-scope finding (`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/*.json` still cite `packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts#…`): confirmed in `platform-core.json`, `api-backend.json` and `access-security.json`. Those symbol anchors resolve through core's re-export, and the files are outside the card's surface. Left to the seat as a possible follow-up; not a finding on this PR.
- SQL push-down: not applicable. The diff holds no query, no id materialisation and no in-app join.
- Security: no changed hunk teaches permission, sharing, credential, token or authentication behaviour.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix, no should-fix.

**`docs/adr/0150-…-keep-the-literal-prefix.md`** (five lines, path prefixes only). Every path and symbol the PR writes exists at this head:

- `packages/metadata-core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts` exists and declares `PACKAGE_SCOPED_TYPES` (`export const`), `PackageScopedHolder` (`export type`, reading `package`, `environment`, `platform`, `residual`, as the amendment note says), `describePackageScopedHolder` (`export function`), `PackageScopedResolution` (`export type`) and `PackageScopedNameRefusedError` (`export class`). The two continuation anchors in the amendment note (`#describePackageScopedHolder`, `#PackageScopedResolution`) follow the re-pointed path and both resolve there.
- `packages/metadata-core/src/package-scoped-resolution.test.ts` exists and holds the pinned `describe` at line 314: "[#32412] a stack's residual as a holder (ADR-0130 D4): named as the top level outside every package body". The ADR quotes its leading part, as it did before. The old path `packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.test.ts` exists on neither this head nor `main`, so the Pins line was a dead path and is now a live one.
- The other pin in that line is untouched and still holds: `packages/runtime/src/app-artifact-handlers.job-pull.test.ts` carries the three quoted `describe` titles (#32412, #32071, #32355).
- No `packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution…` reference is left in the ADR. The two remaining `packages/core/src` anchors name `security/auth-gate.ts`, which is unrelated.
- The re-point is sound against the code: `packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.ts` at this head is a re-export list from `@objectstack/metadata-core`, and its own header names metadata-core as the rule's home. The anchor gate's header gives this remedy for a moved mechanism ("re-anchor it where it lives"). Each sentence reads the same with the new prefix; no ADR prose changed.
- Nothing on `main` moved these files after the merge base: `git diff 149085573d origin/main` over the ADR, the lint pair, `packages/metadata-core/src` and core's re-export file is empty.

**`packages/lint/src/validate-ai-tool-references.ts`**, against the card's nits:

- N1: exact. The one `{@link skillContextResolution}` now reads `{@link skillContextResolver}`, the function declared above it.
- N3: exact, and bounded as the card bounds it. Only the hint of the `ambiguous-in-environment` arm changes, and it names no package. I tried to break it: the lint holder source (`packageScopedHolderSource`) supplies no `platformItem`, and an environment item resolves before any refusal, so every candidate of this arm is a package of the artifact. "Across the artifact's packages" is therefore true for every way the arm is reached. The other two refusal reasons the type admits (`not-held-by-qualifier`, `ambiguous-in-namespace`) are not returned by `resolvePackageScopedHolders`, so the fall-through arm is `ambiguous-in-closure` alone. The new docblock paragraph agrees with the code sentence by sentence.

**`packages/lint/src/validate-ai-tool-references.test.ts`**:

- N2: exact, and a little stronger than asked. The pin adds `toContain('more than one holder in reach')`, which the card names, plus two negations. With an emptied closure the rule answers `outside-closure`, whose message reads "only outside this package's dependency closure", so the first new assertion fails there. The PR body's ablation shows that red; it was not re-run here.
- N3 pin: the fixture has no `manifest`, two package holders and no own pack, which is the `ambiguous-in-environment` path. It asserts that neither the message nor the hint contains "this package", and holds both to one line of at most 200 characters. The control beside it holds that the closure arm's hint still says "this package", so the pin cannot pass by the phrase vanishing everywhere.

**`packages/metadata-core/src/package-closure.ts`** (N4): exact. `resolvePackageScopedHolders` is declared in `package-scoped-resolution.ts` beside that file, and `packages/core/src/index.ts` re-exports core's module, so "`@objectstack/core` re-exports it" is true.

Nits (R1, R2: this record's own ids, apart from the card's N1 to N4), neither affecting correctness or the contract:

- R1 (nit) — ADR-0150 lines 121 and 168 sit under "The tree today (measured on `main` at `0a1b69c0`)" and "(measured on `main` at `fbb62e1c`)". The rule moved to metadata-core later (#37609), so the re-pointed anchor names a file that most likely did not exist at those measured commits. Not measured: neither commit is reachable in this clone. The sentences state list membership, which holds at either path, and the gate's convention is to anchor where the mechanism lives today. Accepted as is.
- R2 (nit) — The new hint omits one more valid fix for a stack with no package: defining the pack on the stack itself, which the rule answers first as the environment's item. The hint is true as written, and the card bounds item 3 to wording the arm without a package. Accepted as is.

The five ADR hunks change only `packages/core/src/package-scoped-resolution.*` → `packages/metadata-core/src/package-scoped-resolution.*`, where each anchored symbol is declared today (core re-exports them); every sentence reads the same. The hint change is one new arm keyed on `refusal.reason === 'ambiguous-in-environment'`; the other two hints and every message are byte-identical. The docblock link now names a declared function.
